## Streyn 1.14.0

Musik is now called **Streyn**, with a new logo.

- **New name everywhere:** apps, server, installers, website, docs and the Discord status say Streyn. The downloads are now `Streyn.apk`, `Streyn.exe` and `Streyn.AppImage`.
- **Updating keeps everything:** older apps update to Streyn by themselves with the update button. On Windows Streyn replaces the old Musik installation and takes your settings and offline playlists along. The server moves from `/opt/musik` to `/opt/streyn` the next time you run the Proxmox script or `streyn-update` (`musik-update` still works); accounts, playlists and your music folder stay as they are. ZimaOS moves its data on the next run of the install command.
- **New logo:** app icons on Android, Windows and Linux, the tab icon in the browser and the website.
- **Playlists in your own order:** drag them in the sidebar or in Library → Playlists. On the phone, hold a playlist for a moment, then drag. The order is saved in your account, so every device shows it the same way.
- **Big player:** the cover always fits between the top bar and the song name, and the title, artist and progress line line up exactly with the cover, in every theme and window size.
- **Search in the title bar** of the desktop app sits exactly in the middle, in every theme.
- **Profile:** pressing the picture again closes the panel instead of opening another one.
